lines.text: Josiah read the Book of the Covenant to all the people and made a covenant before the LORD by the pillar.
Josiah had the articles for Baal and Asherah burned in the fields of Kidron and carried their ashes to Shiloh.
Josiah desecrated Topheth so no one could sacrifice a child to Molech, and he burned up the chariots of the sun.
Josiah pulled down altars that Manasseh had set up, and desecrated high places built by King Saul for Ashtoreth, Chemosh and Milcom.
Josiah burned bones from the tombs at Bethel on the altar, but left the man of God's bones undisturbed.
